name: Touhou Makura Shikyou
source:
Main character is summoned to the Touhou world via a summoning ceremony by a girl Patchouli who is in trouble with a vast collection of books. Protagonist helps her arrange the books, but not only that.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/08/vn-of-month-july-2008-kara-no-shoujo.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公通过召唤仪式被一名陷入书籍困境的女孩帕秋莉召唤到东方世界。主人公帮助她整理书籍，但事情并不止于此。

[来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/08/vn-of-month-july-2008-kara-no-shoujo.html]vndreview[/url]]
